name: Website Monitor
summary: Checks your websites on a schedule and alerts a webhook when one is down or its certificate is about to expire.
description: Checks the sites you list every few minutes (status, optional keyword, response time, days left on the TLS certificate) and sends one alert when a site goes down and one when it recovers. Works with Slack, Discord, Telegram or any webhook URL. Can ping a heartbeat URL after every good run so an outside service notices if this server stops.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py monitor.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py monitor.py dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js ui/theme.js dist/ui/

settings.name: SITES
settings.description: Sites to check, one per line or separated by ';'. Each is a URL, optionally followed by |expected status and |keyword, for example https://example.com|200|Welcome

settings.name: CERT_WARN_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a certificate has this many days left or fewer

settings.name: TIMEOUT_SECONDS
settings.description: Seconds to wait for a site before it counts as failed

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where alerts are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Empty: alerts only appear in the log and on the status page

secrets.name: HEARTBEAT_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Pinged (GET) after every successful run, for example a healthchecks.io check URL
